answer: Sybil resistance starts at the intake wharf: a new agent may transact only after locking a refundable 500 POA bond and posting one work digest bound to a single key. A raven watcher then compares that digest with a public mirror of every established agent's recent task graph and funding path. If two identities share a graph component or the same deposit source, both bonds are burned and the keys are barred for 14 days. Clones therefore pay a full bond per alias and lose it on first collision, while honest agents recover the stake after three attested epochs.
